text: The following report will outline recommendations provided by the Chief Executive Officer regarding exempt staff compensation.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the recommendations contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 27, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo. 2. Directed that the information in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report ( September 27, 2022 ) f rom the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo, remain confidential in its entirety as it contains information about labour relations/employee negotiations.
